statement: Linux and SDL describe Bluetooth input 0x31 and output 0x31 as 78-byte reports with a trailing four-byte little-endian CRC32. Kernel seeds input 0xA1, output 0xA2 and Bluetooth feature responses 0xA3; the CRC covers the seed byte followed by the report excluding its final four bytes. Linux rejects invalid incoming input or feature CRCs. Output CRC generation is a consumer send behavior; no physical actuator acceptance is implied.
